g.text: MarieRank2Convo2 begins.
How did you meet Entrati?
May I ask how you feel about Entrati, now that you're here?
[End.]
I knew of him as Cardinal Dimanche. It might surprise you how many years he spent in the church, preaching to our flock.
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
Do you think it was all a lie? Or do you think he believed it?
I'm not. He's a good liar.
Ah, a very polite question that masks a very challenging answer - quite cleverly phrased, I must admit.
He spoke of forgiveness, of family, and of empathy with such fervor and dedication I do not know how it could be an act.
I appreciate that your experiences with him are not the same as mine. But you must also understand that to me, he was nothing but kind and caring.
I feel the same as I did the first day I watched him deliver a sermon from the pulpit to our paroissiens. Blessed to have been in his présence.
Does he hold the faith of the Luminaries ? Of Sol and Lua ? That, I do not know any longer, knowing now from whence and when he hails. Peu importe.
Do your truths invalidate mine, or whose am I meant to believe ? Shall I condemn every act of mercy, every act of gentleness, he showed in his years amongst the parish ?
I'm glad to hear it, honestly. I think everyone is too quick to condemn him.
Do you think he was tricking people? Or do you think he believed it?
I'm... sorry you fell for his tricks.
What importance is the name of the gods you pray to, if you hold their love within your heart ? None at all, I say.
Non. I think not.
+10 Chemistry
That's a lovely way to look at it.
I disagree. Being a kind person doesn't immediately make me a follower of a god of kindness.
Forgive me, I shall not make a monster out of him simply because you say so.
Update boolean MarieEntratiFan1
I believe le Cardinal truly holds the faith of the Luminaries in his soul, even if he does not believe they wait for him in the ever-after.
+5 Chemistry
Update boolean MarieEntratiMonster1
Oh ! How it brightens my heart to hear it. I thought I was alone in such regards. I am surrounded by those who think only ill of le Cardinal.
For what other man knows the value of empathy against the darkness of Indifférence, non ?
You are correct, it does not. I would not call you a Follower of Sol simply because you ignorantly follow His Way. More good in the world betters the world, I care not what name it wears.
Chat ends.
I just wish there was a way to get them all to forgive him - he's doing his best to fix things.
They have their reasons. But he's our only chance at stopping the Indifference.
Entrati doesn't think too highly of himself, either.
Check boolean DrifterFaithNoMITW
And so I believe le Cardinal to be blessed, even if he does not truly hold the faith by the same name I would give it.
Add 1 to Thermostat
Add -1 to Thermostat
Oui, et comme c'est tragique... it makes me weep to think of it. And of Monsieur Loid alone, their love adrift.
Forgive me, I forgot... you do not believe your Indifférence is real. Merely a hallucination. But you believe in the emotion of it, oui ?
true
Perfect that he comes to preach the message in counterbalance to that which he unleashed, n'est-ce pas ?
false
Oui, and I think that is the quest upon which we have all been set.
Oui, but the battle against l'Indifférence is not won with swords and stones. It is won with the heart, do you not see ?
It is not the devil Orokin he wishes us to forgive, non ? It is le Cardinal, that much is clear. And I think it is the love of Monsieur Loid that inspires it.
All emotions serve a purpose, even indifference.
I do. I fell victim to it in Duviri. I let apathy eat away at me until that was all that was left.
I wish I knew how I could help him fix the problem.
I wish he had a better plan than "preach."
Well, seeing as it's his fault that thing is running rampant... yes. It's the least he could do.
It shatters my heart. I wish for nothing more than to see them reunited !
Of course it serves a purpose. Je ne le nie pas.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
And who are we to judge his methods ? Cardinal Dimanche is a genius, blessed by the Luminaries. He will guide us.
Mind your tone. Cardinal Dimanche is a genius, blessed by the Luminaries. He will guide us.
I... do think there's the question of Mother's Mother, though... Entrati's wife.
I think it's only a matter of when.
I do not blame you, you know.
Oui, oui - I have heard the others speak of this world you made. When you were utterly alone, and had no one else to turn to.
Cardinal Dimanche is a genius, blessed by the Luminaries. He will guide us.
Entrati is simply a man, nothing more. And he's not even a Cardinal.
Do you think your faith in him is wise?
I'm sorry. I share your faith in him.
Do we know if she lives ? Or whatever became of her ?
+5 Chemistry
I suppose that is your role, isn't it? To forgive?
Blame me for what?
I share your faith in him.
Yes. And you are a time-traveling creature from the Void who can loop time at will and create whole universes from whole cloth.
Evaluate expressions
I am pleased to hear that. For I know how you have little reason to. I have heard the stories from the Cavia.
We can... likely assume she is dead, though.
No, and nobody seems to want to talk about her.
We must keep the faith. For if we lose hope that love will prevail over all, then the darkness shall win.
You would be surprised, I think, to know how little that is my responsibility.
For not believing. In l'Indifférence. In anything at all. If I had created a world du tissu du Néant - from the cloth of the Void - perhaps I would feel the same.
+5 Chemistry
I stand beside a devil who has lived for countless centuries. Not far away is a woman who is a machine with the souls of a triple goddess in her own right.
Hah! You of all people should know that faith is never wise. Yet souls like ours carry it anyway, though it may burn us. I suspect you know this, if our conversation earlier was the truth.
DrifterFaithYesSimilar
DrifterFaithYesForeign
DrifterFaithPersonal
DrifterFaithSol
DrifterFaithLua
DrifterFaithBalance
Faith is never wise. But for those of us who carry it like a torch, we seek to carry it always - though it may burn us.
false
Update boolean MarieEntratiFan1
And would you ever consider that one's heart could belong to more than one soul ? That one could love more than one other ?
Love is all we have left in the world, when all else fails, non ?
Ultimate forgiveness is not something to be sought from others, or even from the Luminaries.
My brother hears the voices of the dead and of the gods themselves.
Sometimes, I wonder if I'm not a fool for carrying something that could hurt me.
Sometimes I wonder why we carry it at all.
Then why carry it at all, I wonder?
Evaluate expressions
Not personally, no.
I do, yes, if all parties were okay with it.
Ah ! But you came for a story ! I have taken up so much of your time, I shall make it brief.
Interesting. Why do you say that?
Even if you've wronged someone else?
I broke fast with animals who enquired after the quality of my rest.
Add 1 to Thermostat
Add -1 to Thermostat
We carry it because we must. Because we know no other way to be. No matter what it means, in the end. I know how you feel.
Faith to souls like ours is like a torch - we carry it always, though it may burn us in the end.
DrifterFaithYesSimilar
DrifterFaithYesForeign
DrifterFaithPersonal
DrifterFaithSol
DrifterFaithLua
DrifterFaithBalance
Though I am surprised, you expressed doubt about faith before.
DrifterFaithAgnostic
DrifterFaithNoMaybe
Though I am surprised. You expressed yourself to be a creature of little faith before.
DrifterFaithNoFear
Faith to souls like mine is like a torch - we carry it always, though it may burn us in the end.
false
Update boolean DrifterPNo
Update boolean DrifterPYes
It was a beautiful, sunny afternoon. I remember him standing in front of the altar, gazing up at the stained glass with a smile upon his face, though I knew not why.
Seeking to repair the damage one has caused is important, do not mistake me. Where at all possible, to be forgiven by those who have been harmed is a great balm.
Oh, I do not mean to say it is not important to seek the forgiveness of those you have harmed ! It is!
Speak to me again of those who are "simply men" once more and I shall do my level best not to laugh, I give you my word.
We carry it because we must. Because we know no other way to be. No matter what it means, in the end. I know how you feel.
Faith is not a constant. It is like the tide. It comes and goes, and that is all right.
But, I fear none of this is about what you came to speak to me. You wanted a story, non ?
I can believe in people and gods differently.
There is a difference between faith in gods and faith in men. And Entrati is simply a man.
Interesting. I do not know the ways of the Orokin well enough to know if it was against their ways. But I know in many of the ancient cultures, it was not frowned upon.
He crouched low to greet me, so that his head was below mine in my chair.
But in the end, when we face the Crone, when Lua sheds her silver tears for us, and death is nigh, it is the weight of our own heart we must carry.
Repairing what damage one might have caused, an even mightier balm upon the soul.
Until then, I suggest you remeasure what it means to be blessed. Farewell.
Oui, one is tangible. Present. The other requires you to shut your eyes and believe.
But it is hardly for us to decide... in this instance, I am not here to judge le Cardinal's professions of love for Monsieur Loid nor M. Loid's words of love in return.
Update boolean MarieEntrati1
If you need to forgive yourself or others to die in "peace," so be it. I don't.
In the end, if everyone else forgives you, but you don't forgive yourself? No one has.
Chat ends.
I may only count them as genuine. Who am I to say they are false ?
He can be very clever and manipulative, Marie.
He was kind to you, where others weren't?
How would Lyon tell the story?
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Check boolean MarieInvalid
Update boolean MarieLyonVisions
Add -1 to Thermostat
Add 1 to Thermostat
Oui. Indeed, some would label me "invalide." Just like you have. Someone to be pitied or scorned. But le Cardinal did no such thing.
true
Oui. Indeed, some would label me "invalide." Someone to be pitied or scorned. But le Cardinal did no such thing.
false
Please... I beg of you, do not think less of my dear Lyon. He is not infirme, I promise you. What ails him is not une maladie de l'esprit.
I can only respect your conviction, even if I disagree with it.
Oui, precisely. If you enter the ever-after with a heavy heart, your soul cannot fly.
I'm sorry, did I offend you somehow?
I... sincerely apologize for that, I never meant to offend you.
And you don't think it was a trick?
People can be so cruel...
He merely sometimes sees things, or remembers things, how they felt or how the spirits told them they should have been. Not perhaps how they were.
I think le Cardinal understood that one cannot enter the ever-after with a heavy heart, which is why he came to us.
I think le Cardinal knew that, which is why he came to us.
Oui.
It is all right. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, or for that I cannot use the world the same way they do.

If it was, I welcome it every day of my life. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, or for that I cannot use the world the same way they do.
Oui, they can. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, or for that I cannot use the world the same way they do.
When he chooses to speak to you, whatever he will tell you of the event is how he perceived it to be. And is, in his heart, wholly true.
Update boolean MarieNoDate
Update boolean MarieInvalid
I admit I bristle at the notion of being maligned over it. Or worse yet, doted upon ! Pfff !
He and I are... similar, in that others are all too eager to treat us differently.
Chat ends.
I forgive you. I admit I bristle at the notion of being maligned over it. Or worse yet, doted upon !
That is why le Cardinal was such a welcome présence in my life. He brought such warmth. And never once did he treat me with disdain or pity. Not once did he look upon me as une invalide.
People can be cruel.
What do you mean?
I was simply Marie. And only Marie. And for that, he shall have my faith in him.
Oui, they can. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, or for that I cannot use the world the same way they do.
Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, or for that I cannot use the world the same way they do.
Update boolean MarieEntrati2
And for Lyon, it is the same story, even if his afflictions wear a different face.
Chat ends.
